verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair trust-control question for a consumer AI agent product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature. The Analytics API only provides bucketed usage time series for org admins, which is an adjacent feature and not an export of chat history or account data. Thread_id session continuation is likewise not an export.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
